notes: Daily Operations now shows rail-pass information only on dates whose actual day context includes train/rail travel. Rail-pass records no longer appear on flight-only, driving, touring, lodging, or other non-rail days such as Sep 15 SFO→Istanbul. The rail-day requirement is enforced both in secure-record matching and in rail-pass rendering.
name: TEE v3.3.80 — Rail Pass Context Filter
